title: Conformal QED in AdS as a BCFT
summary: We study conformal Quantum Electrodynamics (QED) coupled to either $N_f$ massless fermions or $N_s$ conformally coupled scalars in Euclidean Anti-de Sitter (AdS$_d$) space for $d < 4$. Using the $ε$-expansion around $d=4$, we investigate the associated Boundary Conformal Field Theories (BCFTs) defined by imposing either Dirichlet or Neumann boundary conditions on the gauge field.
